docs.title: Do I need a prescription to order contact lenses?
docs.body: Yes. Upload a photo, send it on WhatsApp, or we use the one on file from a test at our store. Prescriptions under 12 months.

docs.title: Do you sell glasses or sunglasses online?
docs.body: Yes. Frames and sunglasses can be ordered online. Prescription lenses are added in store after a fitting.

docs.title: Delivery and collection
docs.body: Fast delivery across the UAE, or collect from any of our three stores.

docs.title: Can you help with keratoconus if glasses no longer work?
docs.body: Often, yes. We map the shape of your cornea and fit custom lenses: Excellent-KK RGP lenses for mild to advanced cases, and scleral lenses (EyePal, i-Shape) for more advanced or unusual eyes. Each fitting includes follow-up visits.

docs.title: At what age can myopia control start?
docs.body: Your optometrist will advise after a full assessment, based on age, prescription and eye health.
